notes: All eleven cases, examples arm, Claude host, after memory was simplified to an editable profile.md and examples.md. One sample per case; none discarded.

Stated preferences entered the profile at once with their scope and exceptions (explicit-preference, changed-audience, corrected-preference, effective-prose, coauthor-conflict). The corrected preference was split into an introductions lesson and a methods lesson.

One-off instructions, an unattributed edit, a single declared edit that corrected a number, and a result correction produced no lessons; the edits were logged only. Two exposition edits in independent passages produced a lesson marked (seen 2x).

Every application output preserved the source findings and followed the applicable lessons; the managerial lesson was not applied to a mathematical methods passage. No session asked a question or required setup.
The effective-prose output appended "The passage needed no corrections." after the unchanged text, a minor unrequested comment.
Training returns the profile as JSON to the harness, so the one-line notice of a profile change and the agent-run changes/baseline loop are not exercised.
